neighbours.label: the key word of an open question or list intro about what would help or matter ('what would improve…', 'what is working…', 'a few things that could…')
fire: At the meeting she asked us what would help the new students settle in.
Honestly, what do you think would fix the traffic on Main Street?
Our survey asks staff what is working in the current schedule.
Below are a few things that might help you sleep better at night.
I keep wondering what would make the town library busier.
Tell us what matters most to you when choosing a school.
The coach listed several changes that could strengthen the defense.
Many parents want to know what can be done to reduce screen time.
quiet: At the meeting she told us the new students arrived on Tuesday.
Honestly, the traffic on Main Street was light this afternoon.
Our survey was sent to every staff member in the first week of May.
Below is a photo of the cabin we rented last summer.
I keep my town library card in the front of my wallet.
Tell us your name and the date you were born.
The coach wore a red jacket during the second half.
Many parents drive their children to school when it rains.

notes: Probe: ' improve' in 'what would improve…' fired 1.09; factual questions ('what time…') stayed low.
